lines: It was well past the agreed upon meeting time.
I was supposed to meet up here with Hebiko and Shikanosuke, who I had sent to search for informationー
Ohh, finally you're here. You're late.
We had finally managed to regroup, but somehow those two were looking completely defeated.
Was it that hard? Anyway, let me know the results of your investigation.
Ahh, y-yeah... the investigation. Apparently, if you are looking for something in this city, it's best to ask "Madam."
I see, a brothel... The best spot for an information broker to hide.
In a City of Darkness like this, you would always find an information broker.
Instead of recklessly searching for someone and disrupting the "peace of the underworld,"
it was more efficient to use an information broker to avoid trouble, even if you had to pay for it.
I had already received funds for that from Headmistress Asagi.
To be honest, I had been a little concerned about whether they'd be able to gather information in a City of Darkness, but it appeared that there had been nothing to worry about.
They somehow looked really exhausted though.
Fuma-chan, where's Murasaki-sensei? Wasn't she with you?
Yeah, but she has another mission to take care of. She left us in charge of bringing back Kiryu Sabato.
R-, r-r-really!? Just the three of us!?
It's just looking for a person, what are you so scared of? Not like he's gonna eat you.
Hm? Anyway, let's get going. To Club "Persona"!
